title: Multi-View Trust Evaluation for Collaborator Selection via Evidential Deep Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.25235v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Selection of trustworthy collaborators in distributed systems is critical for efficient task completion, necessitating the inference of trustworthiness from their past collaboration experience. However, as a collaborator serves distinct devices across diverse scenarios in past collaborations, its trust-related data, observed from different device-specific views, is inherently multi-source, heterogeneous, and uneven in quality. Consequently, achieving accurate trust evaluations for collaborator selection remains a major challenge. To tackle these issues, we propose a novel multi-view evidential learning (MVE) based trust evaluation method. First, to accommodate the multi-source heterogeneity of observed trust-related data, we model each task owner who has interacted with a potential collaborator as an independent observational view, enabling the evaluation of the collaborator's view-specific trust. translated_title: 基于证据深度学习的多视角信任评估用于协作者选择
translated_abstract: 在分布式系统中，选择可信赖的协作者对于高效完成任务至关重要，这需要从其过去的协作经验中推断其可信度。然而，由于协作者在过去协作中服务于不同设备并处于多样化场景，其信任相关数据从不同设备特定视角观察，本质上具有多源、异构和质量不均的特点。因此，实现准确的信任评估以进行协作者选择仍是一个重大挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新颖的基于多视角证据学习（MVE）的信任评估方法。首先，为适应观察到的信任相关数据的多源异构性，我们将每个与潜在协作者有过交互的任务所有者建模为独立的观察视角，从而能够评估该协作者的视角特定信任。其次，为解决动态演化问题……
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多视角证据深度学习的信任评估方法，通过将任务所有者建模为独立视角并处理动态演化，以解决分布式系统中协作者选择的多源异构信任数据挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-view evidential deep learning-based trust evaluation method that models task owners as independent views and handles dynamic evolution, addressing the multi-source heterogeneous trust data challenge for collaborator selection in distributed systems.
